sara (customer-success): Quick alert — a few EU onboarding projects have stalled embedding indexing after last night's reindex. ClearPath said their demo is blocked. Need a short customer-facing status + RCA and a mitigation/comp offer we can send.
jon (eng): RCA (short): a recent change removed an internal safety throttle which allowed too many concurrent shard workers. One EU node hit transient disk pressure and retries caused a backlog. Immediate fix: paused the global backfill, killed retrying workers, cleared node cache, and restarted a rate-limited backfill. ETA ~16–18h. We can run a targeted expedited reindex (1–2h) on request.
amanda (cs lead): Draft for customers (short): "Hi <Name>, quick update: during a scheduled indexing job last night a safety throttle was inadvertently removed, which led to retries on an EU node and slowed indexing for a small number of onboarding projects (including yours). We paused the job, addressed the retry storm, and resumed a rate-limited backfill. We expect completion within ~16–18 hours. If you need demo-ready results sooner, reply and we can run an expedited targeted reindex (~1–2 hours); we will cover the cost for trial customers. As an apology we've applied one week of Dedicated credits to your account. — Amanda, CS"
sara (customer-success): Good. Amanda — send to affected leads (ClearPath, Mingle Labs, BrightLeaf) and cc me + eng. Update customer-health: Impact=Indexing delay, ETA=16–18h, Credit=1 week, Owner=amanda. Escalate to P2 if >20h or new 5xx spikes.
incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0842 — EU embedding backfill overload. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0842
jon (eng): Monitoring in place; I'll land the concurrency fix tomorrow morning.
amanda (cs lead): Sent to leads and pasted outbound copy here. Will log replies and any requests for expedited reindex in this thread. :thumbsup:
